biography.bio:
A decorated veteran turned high-school history teacher; the team's weapons specialist and its steadiest shot.

Masks: Blaster, Blaster II, New Blaster (wearing Blaster).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.i7jFeb5bzN0U3VKv]{Firecracker}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.bQJHSrREvvCnE05C]{Hurricane}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Fires a beam of searing heat.

Hondo MacLean's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
A wider-angle Blaster that sprays heat across everything in front of the wearer.

Hondo MacLean's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
A Blaster with a holographic double - planned for the line, never sold.

Hondo MacLean's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Holo-Double: +2 Evasion until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You have reinforced your helmet. While you wear a mask, you have +1 Toughness on top of the helmet's own.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: +1 Toughness while you wear a mask.

system.description:
You drive with one hand and aim with the other. A vehicle you are driving has Edge on its Targeting Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive has Edge on its Targeting Tests (its weapons).
